name: discord-dot
description: A Cloudflare Worker and Durable Object Discord mention bridge for a ChatGPT dot.

scripts.build:bundle: WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/wrangler && esbuild dist/wrangler/index.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 '--external:cloudflare:*' --loader:.txt=text --outfile=dist/index.js
scripts.build: npm run build:admin-css && npm run build:bundle
scripts.test: vitest run --exclude test/deployment-runtime.test.ts --exclude test/worker-runtime-redirect.test.ts --exclude test/worker-runtime-callback.test.ts --exclude test/worker-runtime-alarm.test.ts --exclude test/terraform-artifact.test.ts
scripts.verify:production-runtime: vitest run test/deployment-runtime.test.ts test/worker-runtime-redirect.test.ts test/worker-runtime-callback.test.ts test/worker-runtime-alarm.test.ts
scripts.check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run verify:deployment-artifact
